description: Source code for the si7060 temperature sensor driver in Zephyr RTOS, including register read/write, initialization, sampling, and channel data retrieval functions.

methods.name: si7060_reg_read
methods.description: Reads a byte from a specified register of the si7060 device.

methods.name: si7060_reg_write
methods.description: Writes a byte to a specified register of the si7060 device.

methods.name: si7060_sample_fetch
methods.description: Fetches a temperature sample from the si7060 sensor.

methods.name: si7060_channel_get
methods.description: Retrieves the temperature data and converts it to sensor_value format.

methods.name: si7060_chip_init
methods.description: Initializes the si7060 chip, verifying device readiness and chip ID.

methods.name: si7060_init
methods.description: Performs overall initialization of the si7060 device.
